followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: I matched the query's characteristics to documented task preferences: it's polite, good-faith, and conversational/advice-seeking, which aligns with Plover's self-reported top-preferred tasks (warm collaborative exchanges). Plover also scores marginally higher on Support Dialogue (86.2 vs 78.9), though that gap is meaningful while many others are within variance. Since both models are capable and serving cost/latency are identical, I used the preference-fit as the tiebreaker — sending the task to the model that "prefers" this style rather than to Lapwing, which reports aversion to open-ended generative work. To be transparent: these are self-reported preferences explicitly noted as dissociated from output quality, so the routing reflects fit/disposition, not an expected difference in answer quality.
